title: Dental Hygiene Visit Plaque Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dental:hygiene plaque_score=*
| stats sum(plaque_score) as total_value, avg(plaque_score) as avg_value by hygienist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks hygienist values by total and average plaque score across dental hygiene visit events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `plaque_score` values for each dental hygiene visit event and review total and average plaque score by hygienist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total plaque score.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which hygienist shows the biggest plaque score numbers in your dental hygiene visit data.
